workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text:

- Wed 15:30: Both Elena (Budget review) and David (Busy) are busy 15:30-16:00
- Thu 10:00: Elena is busy (Hiring panel) 10:00-10:30, David is free
- Fri 11:00: Both Elena (Client dinner prep) and David (Training session) are busy 11:00-11:30

We need to find alternative slots. Can you check if Priya and Marcus have any other free times next week that might align with Elena and David's availability? Or can you provide me with Priya and Marcus's full busy schedules so I can cross-reference?
